name: streak-snippets
description: Snippets, commands, and developer productivity tools for the Streak.js React framework

streak.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable or disable real-time Streak framework diagnostics

streak.rules.widgetPlaceholderProps.seve.description: Severity for missing <WidgetPlaceholder> id/type props rule (streak:S101, streak:S102)

streak.rules.dataHandlerStatus.severity.description: Severity for missing status return in data handlers rule (streak:S201)

streak.rules.dataHandlerAsync.severity.description: Severity for data handler must be async rule (streak:S202)

streak.rules.invalidHandlerStatus.severi.description: Severity for invalid HTTP status code rule (streak:S203)

streak.rules.missingDefaultExport.severi.description: Severity for missing default export rule (streak:S301)

streak.rules.reactHooksNotAllowed.severi.description: Severity for React hooks not allowed in static widgets rule (streak:S302)

streak.rules.unsafeWidgetDataAccess.seve.description: Severity for unsafe widget props.data access rule (streak:S303)

streak.rules.invalidWidgetPropsContract..description: Severity for invalid widget props contract rule (streak:S304)

streak.rules.scriptClosureCapture.severi.description: Severity for Script closure variable capture rule (streak:S401)

streak.rules.invalidScriptSignature.seve.description: Severity for invalid Script callback signature rule (streak:S402)

streak.rules.importInsideScript.severity.description: Severity for module imports inside Script rule (streak:S403)

streak.rules.asyncScriptCallback.severit.description: Severity for async Script callback rule (streak:S404)

streak.rules.scriptRequiredId.severity.description: Severity for missing Script component id rule (streak:S405)

streak.rules.invalidDynamicComponentId.s.description: Severity for invalid <Dynamic> component id rule (streak:S501)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
